success.description: Offline ranking-calibration experiment passes only if hit_at_1 does not regress and miss_top1 does not increase.

gates.rule: hit_at_1 rate >= baseline on canary set
Share of miss with feature_missing co-occurrence must not rise due to the change

rollback.description: Any trigger aborts canary; no RC; no Core PR.

triggers.rule: hit_at_1 drops by more than 2pp vs baseline
Production Prediction Core changed before status=pass
